methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); midstream signals

pit_profile.why: Commodity exposure (Targa Resources Corp. FY2017 10-K): Our primary natural gas gathering and processing arrangements that expose us to commodity price risk are our percent-of-proceeds arrangements. Distribution policy: 'even if our business experiences fluctuations in cash from operations due to seasonal and cyclical factors' (the boilerplate of the dividend policy, not a statement that the business is cyclical: the CHTR reading). Risk factor: 'Our cash flow is affected by supply and demand for natural gas and NGL products and by natural gas, NGL, crude oil and condensate prices, and decreases in these prices could adversely affect our results of operations and financial condition.'; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a midstream natural gas company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', ENERGY_TRANSITION to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining': none names midstream energy but ENERGY_TRANSITION, whose oil, gas and coal reserves and refining a gatherer and processor does not hold (the BKR reading: the Targa Resources Corp. FY2017 10-K names no reserves of Targa's, and its refinery services are NGL balancing for refiners, 'In our refinery services business, we typically provide NGL balancing services via contractual arrangements with refiners to purchase and/or market propane and to supply butanes.'; the Channelview Splitter is a fee-based service under construction: 'entered into a long-term, fee-based agreement (“Splitter Agreement”) under which Targa Terminals will build and operate a 35,000 Bbl/d crude oil and condensate splitter at our Channelview Terminal on the Houston Ship Channel (“Channelview Splitter”).' 'The Channelview Splitter is expected to be completed in the second quarter of 2018, and has an estimated total cost of approximately $140 million.'); the 10-Ks' 'offshore' is the Gulf Coast and its waters, the Targa Resources Corp. FY2017 10-K does not name cloud, and no 10-K names e-commerce or streaming), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here, with the greenhouse gas risk factor: 'The adoption and implementation of climate change legislation or regulations restricting emissions of GHGs could result in increased operating costs and reduced demand for the products and services we provide.' (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: EPS -55.1%/yr (worst year FY11-FY15, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +10.8%/yr (Q4 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 7.2-yr ex-FY10 ex-FY16 ex-FY17 median

BULL.desc: EPS +10.8%/yr (FY11-FY15 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +63.4%/yr (best 2-yr run FY11-FY15, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: TRGP (retrospective, 2018-03-23) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.39x (80.5% downside to Bear $9 / +57.9% upside to Bull $73) | Adj composite 3.45 vs market 2.01: gap +1.44 [UNDERVALUED] | +21% above the EPP floor $38 (35x FY18E $1.09) | Conservative 2-yr case: +47.4% total (+23.7%/yr) | At 42.4x FY18E the 15% hurdle price $61 sits at or below the BASE case; Gathering and Processing +35.5% and Logistics and Marketing +2.4% operating margin in Q4 2017, forward revenues +34.3% (no FY18 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2017 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a midstream natural gas company on this date; none has dated evidence.
